strings.zh: 这里是１１号道路{NEWLINE}西　地鼠洞穴
strings.en: Rt. 11{NEWLINE}West to Diglett’s Cave
strings.notes: US 0346/0; modernised from US 0346#0

strings.zh: 这个洞穴是地鼠洞穴。
strings.en: Diglett’s Cave
strings.notes: US 0346/1; modernised from US 0346#1

strings.zh: 小妹妹,你这只青绵鸟{NEWLINE}养得很健康嘛！
strings.en: Well now, little girl, that Swablu of{NEWLINE}yours looks healthy as can be!

strings.zh: 我刚遇到这只青绵鸟的时候{NEWLINE}它受了很重的伤呢,{CLEAR}我可是花了好大功夫{CLEAR}才帮它恢复过来呢。
strings.en: When I first found this Swablu, it was{NEWLINE}badly hurt.{SCROLL}It took a lot of work to nurse it back{NEWLINE}to health.

strings.zh: 是呀是呀,{NEWLINE}叔叔我做梦都想要一只青绵鸟,{CLEAR}尤其是像这只一样{CLEAR}毛色这么漂亮的青绵鸟。{SCROLL}正好叔叔这里有一只生龙活虎的烈雀,{NEWLINE}跟你的青绵鸟交换怎么样？
strings.en: Yes, yes! I’ve always dreamed of having{NEWLINE}a Swablu, especially one with feathers{CLEAR}as pretty as this one’s.{SCROLL}As it happens, I’ve got a lively Spearow{NEWLINE}right here. How about trading it for{CLEAR}your Swablu?
strings.notes: ext-review B-012

strings.zh: 不了叔叔,{NEWLINE}我并没有收服这只小青绵鸟,{CLEAR}我只是在照顾受伤的它而已啦。
strings.en: No thanks, mister. I didn’t catch this{NEWLINE}little Swablu.{SCROLL}I’m just looking after it because it got{NEWLINE}hurt.

strings.zh: 什么啊！野生的青绵鸟啊。{NEWLINE}害得我还费事去抓了只烈雀。{SCROLL}既然是野生的那我就不客气了,{NEWLINE}你这小鬼赶紧给我让开！
strings.en: What? It’s a wild Swablu? And I went to{NEWLINE}all the trouble of catching a Spearow...{SCROLL}Well, if it’s wild, I won’t hold back. Out{NEWLINE}of my way, kid!

strings.zh: 小青绵鸟是我的朋友,{NEWLINE}而且它才刚恢复健康,{CLEAR}叔叔你不可以抓它！
strings.en: Little Swablu is my friend, and it only{NEWLINE}just got better!{SCROLL}You can’t catch it, mister!

strings.zh: 臭小孩让开,{NEWLINE}你哪知道这种珍稀精灵的价值！{CLEAR}抓它卖给有钱人{CLEAR}我就能大赚一笔啦,哈哈哈！
strings.en: Move it, brat! You’ve no idea what a{NEWLINE}rare Pokémon like this is worth!{SCROLL}I’ll catch it, sell it to some rich folks{NEWLINE}and make a killing! Ha ha ha!

strings.zh: 要去阻止青绵鸟被抓吗？
strings.en: Stop Swablu from being caught?

strings.zh: 滚边去！
strings.en: Get lost!

strings.zh: 走你！
strings.en: Off you go!

strings.zh: 青绵鸟快逃啊！
strings.en: Swablu, run away!

strings.zh: 哈哈,逃得掉才怪！
strings.en: Ha ha, it’s not getting away!

strings.zh: 你这个坏人！{NEWLINE}快把青绵鸟还给我！
strings.en: You bad man! Give Swablu back!

strings.zh: 真是个无聊的小鬼,滚开滚开！
strings.en: Annoying brat. Get lost, get lost!
strings.notes: tone review: 小鬼 contemptuous 'brat', 滚开 rude 'get lost'; kept rude (D-0627)

strings.zh: 呜呜呜,怎么能这样！
strings.en: Waaah... How could you!
{VAR:0103:0}: Stop right there!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这位小妹妹{NEWLINE}照顾了青绵鸟这么久,{CLEAR}即便是收服也应该是她有优先权！{CLEAR}你这样的行为未免太过分了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This girl has been caring for{NEWLINE}that Swablu all this time.{SCROLL}If anyone gets to catch it, it should be{NEWLINE}her!{SCROLL}What you’re doing is way out of line.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你没看到人家和精灵{NEWLINE}情投意合吗？{CLEAR}你这样上去去强行收服青绵鸟,{CLEAR}跟抢别人精灵还有分别吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Can’t you see how close she{NEWLINE}and that Pokémon are?{SCROLL}Catching Swablu by force like that is{NEWLINE}just stealing someone else’s Pokémon!

strings.zh: 哟,这还冒出个正义使者来呢。{NEWLINE}看着个架势,{CLEAR}你是想戴鲁比拿小拉达{CLEAR}——多管闲事咯？
strings.en: Well, well, a hero of justice shows up.{SCROLL}What are you, a Houndour chasing{NEWLINE}Rattata? Sticking your nose in where it{CLEAR}doesn’t belong?
strings.notes: Pun on the saying 狗拿耗子，多管闲事 (a dog catching mice = meddling), with Houndour and Rattata.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『请你放弃{NEWLINE}抓青绵鸟的想法！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Please give up on catching{NEWLINE}Swablu!
strings.notes: #21/#22: player tone variants (#22 uses 本姑娘, the female player's sassier line).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哪那么多歇后语,{NEWLINE}赶紧给本姑娘消失！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Enough with the folksy{NEWLINE}sayings! Now get out of this lady’s{CLEAR}sight!
strings.notes: RV012: voice: 本姑娘 self-reference kept

strings.zh: 哼！挡人财路如杀人父母,{NEWLINE}今天就让你知道多管闲事的下场！
strings.en: Hmph! Getting between a man and his{NEWLINE}money is as bad as killing his parents!{CLEAR}Today you’ll see what busybodies get!
strings.notes: tone review: 挡人财路如杀人父母 is a set idiom: blocking a man's money is like killing his parents; idiom kept (D-0627)

strings.zh: 行,出来混的,拳头大的是爷爷,{NEWLINE}我服！
strings.en: All right. Out here, whoever has the{NEWLINE}bigger fists calls the shots. I give!

strings.zh: 谢谢大哥哥,{NEWLINE}如果不是你,{CLEAR}青绵鸟可能就被那个叔叔给抓走啦。{SCROLL}这是我平时给青绵鸟治伤用的树果,{NEWLINE}大哥哥是口袋妖怪训练家的话{CLEAR}应该可以用上的！
strings.en: Thank you, big brother! If it weren’t{NEWLINE}for you, that man might have taken{CLEAR}Swablu away.{SCROLL}These are the Berries I use to heal{NEWLINE}Swablu. You’re a Pokémon Trainer, so{CLEAR}they should come in handy!
strings.notes: #25/#26, #27/#28, #67/#68, #71/#72, #78/#79, #89/#90, #92/#93: male/female player variants (big brother/big sister).

strings.zh: 谢谢大姐姐,{NEWLINE}如果不是你,{CLEAR}青绵鸟可能就被那个叔叔给抓走啦。{SCROLL}这是我平时给青绵鸟治伤用的树果,{NEWLINE}大姐姐是口袋妖怪训练家的话{CLEAR}应该可以用上的！
strings.en: Thank you, big sister!{SCROLL}If it weren’t for you, that man might{NEWLINE}have taken Swablu away.{SCROLL}These are the Berries I use to heal{NEWLINE}Swablu. You’re a Pokémon Trainer, so{CLEAR}they should come in handy!

strings.zh: 没事了，小青绵鸟,{NEWLINE}多亏了这位大哥哥帮忙,{CLEAR}已经没事了哟！
strings.en: It’s all right now, little Swablu. This{NEWLINE}big brother helped us, so everything’s{CLEAR}OK now!

strings.zh: 没事了，小青绵鸟,{NEWLINE}多亏了这位大姐姐帮忙,{CLEAR}已经没事了哟！
strings.en: It’s all right now, little Swablu.{SCROLL}This big sister helped us, so{NEWLINE}everything’s OK now!

strings.zh: 我只是想把这一带丛生的杂草剪一剪,{NEWLINE}弄出一条方便大家行走的路来,{CLEAR}你不要再来碍事了行不行？
strings.en: All I want is to cut back the weeds{NEWLINE}around here and clear a path everyone{CLEAR}can walk on.{SCROLL}Will you quit getting in my way?

strings.zh: 这一带的口袋妖怪们{NEWLINE}都生活在这片草丛里,{CLEAR}你这样剪去这么多草地,{CLEAR}会严重缩减它们的栖息面积的！
strings.en: The Pokémon around here all live in this{NEWLINE}tall grass!{SCROLL}If you cut down this much of it, you’ll{NEWLINE}shrink their habitat badly!

strings.zh: 我又不是要把草从给砍光,{NEWLINE}只是想开出一条好走的路而已啊！{CLEAR}这条路一旦修好,{CLEAR}大家的出行都会很方便的！
strings.en: I’m not clearing out all the grass! I{NEWLINE}just want to open up an easy path!{SCROLL}Once this path is done, getting around{NEWLINE}will be much easier for everyone!

strings.zh: 你只考虑你的方便了,{NEWLINE}你有考略过失去栖息地的口袋妖怪们,{CLEAR}它们该怎么生活吗？{CLEAR}在草丛里多绕两圈又不会怎样,{CLEAR}何必去破坏环境呢！
strings.en: You’re only thinking about your own{NEWLINE}convenience!{SCROLL}Have you thought about how the Pokémon{NEWLINE}will live once they lose their home?{SCROLL}Taking the long way around the grass{NEWLINE}won’t hurt anyone.{SCROLL}Why wreck the environment?

strings.zh: 人要保护自然没错,{NEWLINE}可是人也要改造自然啊！{CLEAR}不然我们人类社会怎么走到今天的！
strings.en: Sure, people should protect nature.{NEWLINE}But people have to shape nature too!{SCROLL}How else do you think human society got{NEWLINE}where it is today?

strings.zh: 改造自然不是让你去破坏环境,{NEWLINE}不是让你改造完之后{CLEAR}造成口袋妖怪们无家可归。
strings.en: Shaping nature doesn’t mean wrecking{NEWLINE}the environment and leaving Pokémon{CLEAR}homeless when you’re done!

strings.zh: 我就是想修一条好走的路而已,{NEWLINE}你哪那么多歪理啊,{CLEAR}一边凉快去吧！
strings.en: I just want to make a decent path!{SCROLL}Enough of your twisted logic. Go take a{NEWLINE}hike!

strings.zh: 飞天螳螂,使用居合斩清理一下……
strings.en: Scyther, use Cut to clear this out...

strings.zh: 你休想破坏草地！{NEWLINE}电击兽使用电磁波！
strings.en: I won’t let you destroy this grass!{NEWLINE}Electabuzz, use Thunder Wave!

strings.zh: 哎哟……麻了！
strings.en: Ow... I’m paralyzed!

strings.zh: 你这个家伙是想干架是不是啊！
strings.en: So you’re looking for a fight, huh?

strings.zh: 路过的训练家你好,{NEWLINE}我正在准备为枯叶市的郊区{CLEAR}修剪出一条好走的路,{CLEAR}结果去碰到这家伙出来碍事。{CLEAR}能麻烦你跟我一起赶走他吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey there, Trainer. I’m trying to cut{NEWLINE}an easy path out here on the edge of{CLEAR}Vermilion City.{SCROLL}But this guy keeps getting in my way.{NEWLINE}Could you help me run him off?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: Route branch: #40 (side with the path-cutter) / #43 (side with the conservationist). Follow-ups: cutter side #41, #44, #46–#52, #55, #57, #59, #61; conservationist side #42, #45, #53, #56, #58, #60, #62 (by content).

strings.zh: 干架就干架,{NEWLINE}谁让你先破坏草地的！
strings.en: Fine, let’s fight! You started it by{NEWLINE}wrecking the grass!

strings.zh: 哎呀！你这个家伙真是烦死了！
strings.en: Argh! You are such a pain!

strings.zh: 路过的训练家你好,{NEWLINE}我发现这个人想破坏{CLEAR}这一带精灵们的栖息地,{CLEAR}我努力劝阻他,他却无动于衷。{CLEAR}能请你帮我一起阻止他吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey there, Trainer.{SCROLL}This man wants to destroy the home of{NEWLINE}the Pokémon around here.{SCROLL}I’ve tried to talk him out of it, but he{NEWLINE}won’t listen.{SCROLL}Could you help me stop him?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 太好了,有你帮助的话{NEWLINE}肯定能赶走这个烦人的家伙！
strings.en: Great! With your help, we’ll surely run{NEWLINE}this pest off!

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意帮我保护大自然,{NEWLINE}我们这就来阻止他破坏草地吧！
strings.en: Thank you for helping me protect{NEWLINE}nature! Let’s stop him from wrecking{CLEAR}this grass!

strings.zh: 你听好了,{NEWLINE}我对你的干扰已经忍无可忍,{CLEAR}现在请你立刻给我离开,{CLEAR}不要再妨碍我修剪草地。
strings.en: Listen here. I’ve had it with your{NEWLINE}meddling.{SCROLL}Leave right now, and stop getting in the{NEWLINE}way of my grass cutting.

strings.zh: 保护环境人人有责,{NEWLINE}我绝不会让你破坏这里的生态！
strings.en: Protecting the environment is{NEWLINE}everyone’s job! I will never let you{CLEAR}ruin this ecosystem!

strings.zh: 那看来这场精灵对战是不可避免了。
strings.en: Then I guess a Pokémon battle can’t be{NEWLINE}avoided.

strings.zh: 哼,我是不会屈服于你的暴力的,{NEWLINE}想打的话就来吧！
strings.en: Hmph! I won’t give in to your violence.{NEWLINE}If you want a fight, bring it on!
strings.notes: RV012: softened: 暴力 = violence, not bullying (D-1785)

strings.zh: 我告诉你,{NEWLINE}你现在立刻放弃破坏草地的想法,{CLEAR}然后离开这里,{CLEAR}不然我就不客气了。
strings.en: Listen. Give up on wrecking this grass{NEWLINE}right now and leave, or I won’t go easy{CLEAR}on you.

strings.zh: 我今天还就是剪定了,{NEWLINE}你能怎么着啊！
strings.en: I’m cutting this grass today, no matter{NEWLINE}what!{SCROLL}What are you going to do about it?

strings.zh: 那我就只能把你赶走了！
strings.en: Then I’ll just have to run you off!

strings.zh: 看把你能的！{NEWLINE}来啊！谁怕谁！
strings.en: Big talk! Come on, then! I’m not scared{NEWLINE}of you!

strings.zh: 我来对付他的三只精灵,{NEWLINE}剩下的3只拜托你了。
strings.en: I’ll take on his three Pokémon. Please{NEWLINE}handle the other three.

strings.zh: 快带着你的精灵去疗伤吧！{NEWLINE}别在这碍事了。
strings.en: Hurry and take your Pokémon to get{NEWLINE}healed! And stop getting in the way.

strings.zh: 你这样毫无顾忌地破坏环境,{NEWLINE}早晚是要遭报应的！
strings.en: Wrecking the environment without a{NEWLINE}second thought like that... It’s going{CLEAR}to come back to bite you one day!

strings.zh: 这下你该放弃破坏环境了吧,{NEWLINE}乖乖地带着你的精灵去疗伤吧！
strings.en: Now will you give up on wrecking the{NEWLINE}environment?{CLEAR}Be good and go heal your Pokémon!
strings.notes: guide-review: 乖乖地 has no gender; "good boy" → "Be good" (addressee is trainer 534)

strings.zh: 你这种人简直就是在阻碍社会进步！
strings.en: People like you are what’s holding{NEWLINE}society back!

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我赶走了那家伙,{NEWLINE}这样我就可以安心修剪这里的草丛了。{CLEAR}这是我的一点心意请你笑纳。
strings.en: Thanks for helping me run that guy off.{NEWLINE}Now I can trim the grass here in peace.{SCROLL}Here’s a little something to show my{NEWLINE}thanks.

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我保护了这片草地,{NEWLINE}这里的口袋妖怪们肯定也会感激你的！{CLEAR}这是我的一点心意请你收下。
strings.en: Thank you for helping me protect this{NEWLINE}grass! I’m sure the Pokémon here are{CLEAR}grateful too!{SCROLL}Please accept this as a token of my{NEWLINE}thanks.

strings.zh: 这片草地长得可真茂盛,{NEWLINE}看来开一条新路并非那么容易啊。
strings.en: This grass is really thick.{SCROLL}Guess cutting a new path isn’t so easy{NEWLINE}after all.

strings.zh: 能够保护这片草地真是多亏了你,{NEWLINE}但是要不碰草地回到枯叶市{CLEAR}确实是挺绕的……
strings.en: I owe it to you that this grass is safe.{NEWLINE}Still, getting to Vermilion City without{CLEAR}crossing it means a long detour...

strings.zh: 青绵鸟『Swa——lu！
strings.en: Swablu: Swa-lu!

strings.zh: 这只青绵鸟不就是5号路小屋里{NEWLINE}那个女孩饲养的青绵鸟吗！？{SCROLL}要把青绵鸟带走吗？
strings.en: Wait, isn’t this the Swablu that belongs{NEWLINE}to the girl in the house on Route 5?!{SCROLL}Take Swablu with you?

strings.zh: 要把青绵鸟带走吗？
strings.en: Take Swablu with you?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小妹妹,{NEWLINE}跟你商量个事吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hey there, little girl. Can I{NEWLINE}talk something over with you?
strings.notes: RV012: omission: 小妹妹 address

strings.zh: 什么事呀大哥哥？
strings.en: What is it, big brother?

strings.zh: 什么事呀大姐姐？
strings.en: What is it, big sister?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『其实这只青绵鸟,{NEWLINE}是5号路的一位小姐饲养的,{CLEAR}前段时间因为有坏人想要抢走它,{CLEAR}它才不得已逃走了。{CLEAR}我答应了那位小姐{CLEAR}要把青绵鸟给找回去的,{CLEAR}所以你能让我把它带回去吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Actually, this Swablu belongs{NEWLINE}to a young woman on Route 5.{SCROLL}A while ago, some bad people tried to{NEWLINE}steal it, so it had to run away.{SCROLL}I promised her I’d find Swablu and bring{NEWLINE}it back. So will you let me take it home?
strings.notes: Route branch: #73 (take Swablu back now) / #77 (ask the owner first; she lets the girl keep it, #92/#93).

strings.zh: 我说第一次见青绵鸟的时候,{NEWLINE}它怎么伤痕累累疲惫不堪呢,{CLEAR}原来是这么回事呀。{SCROLL}小青绵鸟既然是那位姐姐丢失的,{NEWLINE}理应还给她才是。{CLEAR}只是我照顾了小青绵鸟这么久了,{CLEAR}好舍不得它呀。
strings.en: So that’s why Swablu was so hurt and{NEWLINE}worn out when I first saw it.{SCROLL}If it belongs to that lady, it should go{NEWLINE}back to her.{SCROLL}It’s just that I’ve looked after it for{NEWLINE}so long... I’ll miss it so much.

strings.zh: 大哥哥你能不能{NEWLINE}跟那位姐姐商量一下,{CLEAR}以后由我来照顾小青绵鸟啊,{CLEAR}我保证会小青绵鸟跟我一起{CLEAR}绝对会健康快乐的！
strings.en: Big brother, could you ask that lady if{NEWLINE}I can be the one looking after Swablu?{SCROLL}I promise Swablu will be healthy and{NEWLINE}happy with me!

strings.zh: 大姐姐你能不能{NEWLINE}跟那位姐姐商量一下,{CLEAR}以后由我来照顾小青绵鸟啊,{CLEAR}我保证会小青绵鸟跟我一起{CLEAR}绝对会健康快乐的！
strings.en: Big sister, could you ask that lady if I{NEWLINE}can be the one looking after Swablu?{SCROLL}I promise Swablu will be healthy and{NEWLINE}happy with me!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『对不起啊小妹妹,{NEWLINE}青绵鸟毕竟是人家的,{CLEAR}我既然答应了人家,{CLEAR}现在就必须把青绵鸟带回去了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m sorry, little girl. Swablu{NEWLINE}belongs to someone else, and I made her{CLEAR}a promise. I have to take it back now.
strings.notes: RV012: omission: 小妹妹 address

strings.zh: 唔……好吧……{NEWLINE}回到原来的主人那里,{CLEAR}小青绵鸟也会高兴吧！
strings.en: Mm... OK... I bet little Swablu will be{NEWLINE}happy to go back to its real owner!

strings.zh: 小青绵鸟,{NEWLINE}你就要回到你的主人那里了,{CLEAR}想必你会很高兴吧……{SCROLL}跟你相处的这段时间我很开心呐,{NEWLINE}回去之后你也不要忘了我呀！
strings.en: Little Swablu, you’re going home to your{NEWLINE}owner. You must be so happy...{SCROLL}I had so much fun with you. Don’t{NEWLINE}forget me when you get back!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好了青绵鸟,{NEWLINE}咱们回去吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All right, Swablu. Let’s go{NEWLINE}home!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『唔……好吧,{NEWLINE}那我回去问一下那位小姐。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Mm... All right. I’ll go back{NEWLINE}and ask her.

strings.zh: 太好啦！谢谢大哥哥！{NEWLINE}请你一定转告那位姐姐{CLEAR}我绝对会好好照顾青绵鸟的！
strings.en: Yay! Thank you, big brother! Please{NEWLINE}tell that lady I’ll take really good{CLEAR}care of Swablu!

strings.zh: 太好啦！谢谢大姐姐！{NEWLINE}请你一定转告那位姐姐{CLEAR}我绝对会好好照顾青绵鸟的！
strings.en: Yay! Thank you, big sister!{SCROLL}Please tell that lady I’ll take really{NEWLINE}good care of Swablu!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『事情就是这样的,{NEWLINE}然后我就把青绵鸟给带回来了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So that’s what happened, and{NEWLINE}I brought Swablu back.

strings.zh: 天啊,我还以为{NEWLINE}再也见不到青绵鸟了呢！{CLEAR}你居然真的把它给找回来了！{CLEAR}谢谢！真的是太感谢了！{CLEAR}我都不知道说什么好了,{CLEAR}这个礼物就当是我的心意了！
strings.en: Oh my goodness, I thought I’d never{NEWLINE}see Swablu again! You actually found it!{SCROLL}Thank you! Thank you so much! I don’t{NEWLINE}know what to say...{SCROLL}Please take this gift as my thanks!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『当时为了找回青绵鸟{NEWLINE}而从你这里带走的卡蒂狗……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: About the Growlithe I{NEWLINE}borrowed from you to help find Swablu...
strings.notes: #82/#83 vs #84/#85: Growlithe or Bulbasaur, whichever the Route 5 woman lent (alternate ids, as 0322/0326).

strings.zh: 哎呀,卡蒂狗嘛……{NEWLINE}我看它跟着你非常的开心呢,{CLEAR}似乎是找到属于它的归宿了。{SCROLL}你以后就带着卡蒂狗旅行吧,{NEWLINE}相信你们可以成为很好的搭档的！
strings.en: Oh, Growlithe?{SCROLL}It looks so happy with you. I think it’s{NEWLINE}found where it belongs.{SCROLL}Take Growlithe with you on your journey{NEWLINE}from now on.{SCROLL}I’m sure you’ll make great partners!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『当时为了找回青绵鸟{NEWLINE}而从你这里带走的妙蛙种子……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: About the Bulbasaur I{NEWLINE}borrowed from you to help find Swablu...

strings.zh: 哎呀,妙蛙种子嘛……{NEWLINE}我看它跟着你非常的开心呢,{CLEAR}似乎是找到属于它的归宿了。{SCROLL}你以后就带着妙蛙种子旅行吧,{NEWLINE}相信你们可以成为很好的搭档的！
strings.en: Oh, Bulbasaur?{SCROLL}It looks so happy with you. I think it’s{NEWLINE}found where it belongs.{SCROLL}Take Bulbasaur with you on your journey{NEWLINE}from now on.{SCROLL}I’m sure you’ll make great partners!

strings.zh: 我经常带一些树果{NEWLINE}来这里喂野生的精灵,{CLEAR}我跟它们都是好朋友哦！
strings.en: I often bring Berries here to feed the{NEWLINE}wild Pokémon. We’re all good friends!

strings.zh: 我和青绵鸟是非常要好的朋友哟！{SCROLL}多亏了大哥哥{NEWLINE}我才能和这个好朋友继续一起玩！
strings.en: Swablu and I are super good friends!{SCROLL}Thanks to you, I can keep playing with{NEWLINE}my friend!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……{NEWLINE}小青绵鸟被抢走了！{CLEAR}哇啊啊啊啊！
strings.en: Waaah... Little Swablu got taken away!{NEWLINE}Waaaaah!

strings.zh: 请大哥哥一定转告那位姐姐{NEWLINE}我绝对会好好照顾青绵鸟的！
strings.en: Big brother, please tell that lady I’ll{NEWLINE}take really good care of Swablu!

strings.zh: 请大姐姐一定转告那位姐姐{NEWLINE}我绝对会好好照顾青绵鸟的！
strings.en: Big sister, please tell that lady I’ll{NEWLINE}take really good care of Swablu!

strings.zh: 青绵鸟在它原来的主人那里还好吗？{NEWLINE}我自己在这里玩的日子好孤单啊……
strings.en: Is Swablu doing well with its real owner?{NEWLINE}It’s so lonely playing here by myself...

strings.zh: 那位姐姐{NEWLINE}答应把青绵鸟留在我这里了！？{SCROLL}太好啦！{NEWLINE}谢谢大哥哥！{CLEAR}我这里还有些树果,{CLEAR}再分你一点吧！
strings.en: That lady said Swablu can stay with me?!{SCROLL}Yay! Thanks, big brother! I still have{NEWLINE}some Berries. Have a few more!

strings.zh: 那位姐姐{NEWLINE}答应把青绵鸟留在我这里了！？{SCROLL}太好啦！{NEWLINE}谢谢大姐姐！{CLEAR}我这里还有些树果,{CLEAR}再分你一点吧！
strings.en: That lady said Swablu can stay with me?!{SCROLL}Yay! Thanks, big sister! I still have{NEWLINE}some Berries. Have a few more!

strings.zh: 以后我就可以永远跟青绵鸟一起{NEWLINE}开开心心地玩了！
strings.en: Now Swablu and I can play happily{NEWLINE}together forever!

strings.zh: 飞天螳螂『Scyyy——！！！
strings.en: Scyther: Scyyy-!!!

strings.zh: 电击兽『Eleee——ta！
strings.en: Electabuzz: Eleee-ta!

strings.zh: 现在认可你的馆主还太少了,{NEWLINE}等你至少取得7枚徽章以后,{CLEAR}才够实力跟我对战。
strings.en: Too few Gym Leaders have recognized{NEWLINE}you yet. Come back when you have at{CLEAR}least seven Badges. Then you’ll be{CLEAR}strong enough to battle me.

strings.zh: 我就喜欢你这种{NEWLINE}看起来阅历丰富的训练家。{CLEAR}你要跟我来场对战吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I love Trainers like you, the kind who{NEWLINE}look like they’ve seen a thing or two.{CLEAR}Want to battle me?{SCROLL}

strings.en: A Double Battle takes at least two{NEWLINE}Pokémon!

strings.zh: 好的,咱们开始吧！
strings.en: All right, let’s begin!

strings.zh: 这种压迫感……真的是强我太多了。
strings.en: That pressure... You’re way stronger{NEWLINE}than me.
